module: Flowgraph node "Set Camera Rotation" (repeat_instant). Applies a rotation (quaternion) to the free camera, entered in the node ('custom' mode) or supplied by a quat pin 'rot' ('from Pin' mode). The camera's current position is kept. The output pin value (quat) returns the applied rotation.
notes: The default rotation quat(0,0,0,0) is not a valid quaternion (not normalized): it is only normalized if the user edits the fields.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the rotation to quat(0,0,0,0), the mode to 'custom' and the mode list.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor properties panel: mode choice, x/y/z/w fields (normalized), buttons "Set from camera" and "Preview". Creates/deletes the 'rot' pin.

work.desc: Switches to the free camera if needed, reads the 'rot' pin in 'from Pin' mode, applies the rotation (SetCamera) and writes the value pin.

drawMiddle.desc: Central area of the node (nothing displayed).

SetCamera.desc: Calls core_camera.setPosRot(0, ...) with the camera's current position and the node's rotation.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the rotation (res.rot) and the mode.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores rotation and mode; recreates the 'rot' pin if needed.
